title: Landnam flow
description: A mission or sequence written as a script: the scenes in order, each with the preset to open and what to do or check there. The Scene Studio walks a flow step by step.

id.description: Same as the file name (for example launch-telescope).

summary.description: One or two plain sentences: what this sequence is and why it matters.

tickets.description: Linear tickets that touch this flow.

steps.description: The scenes in the order the player meets them.

scene.description: Id of a scene script in scenes/.

preset.description: Id of one of that scene's presets. Leave this out to open its starting point.

title.description: A few words: what happens at this step.

instructions.description: Plain language: what to do here, what should happen, what must not.
